programme.title: Sexy Therapy
programme.desc: L'histoire de Nathan Fisher, la trentaine, écrivain vivant à Brooklyn et dont la carrière est au point mort. Sa petite amie vient de le quitter et il apprend que son père est hospitalisé. Il décide alors de retourner en Floride pour s'occuper de sa famille.

programme.title: Let's Dance: Davai, tantsyui!
programme.desc: Nikita, jeune danseur talentueux, s'inscrit au concours « Let's Dance » dans l'espoir de gagner le grand prix et ainsi pouvoir payer l'opération dont son petit frère a besoin.

programme.title: Coup de Foudre: Mode d'Emploi
programme.desc: Werther, un jeune écrivain insouciant et charmant, rencontre Charlotte, l'amour de sa vie. Mais il découvre qu'elle est fiancée. Contre l'avis de son meilleur ami, Werther met son monde sens dessus dessous cultivant l'espoir de conquérir le cœur de sa compagne.

programme.title: Tous les chemins mènent à Rome
programme.desc: Une mère de famille un peu à cran, se voit partir en road trip en Italie avec son amour de jeunesse Italien, afin de rattraper sa fille rebelle, qui souhaite rejoindre New-York à tout prix.

programme.title: Stalked
programme.desc: Après avoir été kidnappée sur le chemin de la pharmacie une jeune mère célibataire est poursuivie par un tueur en série invisible. Cependant derrière son apparence frêle se cache une ancienne militaire qui n'a rien perdu de ses connaissances et de son expérience de guerre. Bien qu'elle ait du mal à découvrir la vérite elle ne se laisse pas facilement abattre.

programme.title: L'auberge de Noël
programme.desc: Deux agents immobiliers se disputent la même annonce et doivent passer du temps ensemble dans une auberge à Noël.

programme.title: Maltese
programme.sub-title: Le Roman du Commissaire - Maltese - Episode 1
programme.desc: En Sicile, dans les années 70, le chef de la police, Maltese, se retrouve mêlé à une enquête qui mettra à jour l'influence généralisée de la mafia dans la région et dévoilera les racines archaïques qui l'ont nourrie.

programme.title: Maltese
programme.sub-title: Le Roman du Commissaire - Maltese - Episode 1
programme.desc: En Sicile, dans les années 70, le chef de la police, Maltese, se retrouve mêlé à une enquête qui mettra à jour l'influence généralisée de la mafia dans la région et dévoilera les racines archaïques qui l'ont nourrie.

programme.title: L'Histoire de l'Amour
programme.desc: L'histoire d'un livre perdu depuis longtemps qui réapparaît mystérieusement et relie un vieil homme à la recherche de son fils à une jeune fille cherchant un remède à la solitude de sa mère.

programme.title: Un hologramme pour le roi
programme.desc: Un homme accepte le job de sa vie dans le but de vendre une technologie d'hologramme à un monarque.

programme.title: Opération Lidice
programme.desc: Le 27 mai 1942, à Prague, l'officier SS Reinhard Heydrich est victime d'un attentat organisé par la résistance

programme.title: The Neighbor
programme.desc: Un homme d'âge moyen voit sa vie bouleversée par une jolie jeune femme.

programme.title: Accélération
programme.desc: Vladik Zorich, un seigneur du crime vicieux, est doublé par son agent le plus fiable, Rhona.

programme.title: Une nouvelle tradition pour Noël
programme.desc: Carol vit pour Noël et sa ville la surnomme « Carol de Noël ». Mais l'arrivée d'un homme séduisant qui remet en question ses traditions pourrait bouleverser ses certitudes.

programme.title: Noël avec ma fille
programme.desc: Deux parents célibataires entrevoient la possibilité d'un Noël romantique, mais découvrent que leurs filles sont en proie à une rivalité féroce à l'école. Lorsque cette rivalité dégénère, l'espoir et la réconciliation pourront-ils mener chacun à un Noël paisible et joyeux ?

programme.title: Le Noël du coeur
programme.desc: Baxter Billings devient le Père Noël secret de sa ville après avoir gagné une fortune. En aidant anonymement les habitants, il se rapproche de Pamela et de son fils… mais ses sentiments compliquent ses fiançailles déjà prévues.

programme.title: Des révélations pour Noël
programme.desc: C'est Noël et Miranda quitte Seattle, valise pleine de cadeaux, pour rejoindre sa famille perdue de vue depuis longtemps à Carlton Heath. Elle espère y retrouver les joyeuses traditions qui lui ont manqué durant son enfance. L'an dernier, Miranda est tombée amoureuse d'Ian, un homme du coin qui l'a aidée dans ses recherches de son père, James Whitcomb, un célèbre acteur de théâtre dont elle pensait qu'il avait un lien avec la ville. À la demande de sa veuve, Margaret, Miranda accepte de garder le secret pour protéger la famille du scandale. Ce Noël, elle craint que l'accueil chaleureux des Whitcomb ne se refroidisse lorsqu'elle reçoit un SMS anonyme d'une personne qui la menace de révéler son identité.

programme.title: La plus belle étoile de Noël
programme.desc: De retour dans sa ville pour Noël, Vanessa, médecin dévouée, hésite entre une promotion prestigieuse et la clinique familiale. Entre ancienne romance et attachement à sa communauté, son cœur balance.

programme.title: Big Daddy
programme.desc: Pour impressionner sa petite amie Vanessa et a la suite d'un quiproquo, Sonny, celibataire endurci, fait croire qu'il est le pere naturel de Julian, un jeune garcon de cinq ans qu'il adopte. C'est la catastrophe et l'enfer des nuits detruites, des seances insupportables de calins sans parler de la chanson du Kangourou, qui font decouvrir a Sony un monde qu'il ignorait totalement.

programme.title: Julie & Julia
programme.desc: En 1948, Paul Child, fonctionnaire américain, arrive à Paris avec son épouse, Julia. Cherchant une occupation dans la capitale française, celle-ci s'inscrit à des cours de cuisine et prend goût à concocter des plats pour son époux et leurs amis. de cette expérience naît un livre de recettes qui rencontre un immense succès. de nos jours, Julie Powell, employée trentenaire de New York, a l'impression de tourner en rond. Son métier l'ennuie et elle jalouse la réussite de ses amies. Pour se divertir, et sur le conseil de son mari Eric, elle décide de lancer un blog culinaire. Elle se donne 365 jours pour réaliser toutes les recettes de Julia Child...

programme.title: Copains pour toujours 2
programme.desc: Espérant offrir une vie plus équilibrée à sa famille, Lenny quitte l'hystérie de Hollywood et revient s'installer dans la petite ville où il a grandi. Pourtant, entre ses anciens amis, leurs enfants, les grandes brutes et les petits excités, les chauffeurs de bus fous, les flics bourrés à skis et les 400 invités d'une fête costumée complètement déchaînés, il va vite découvrir que même si vous fuyez la folie, parfois, elle vous poursuit où que vous alliez…

programme.title: Coup de foudre et conséquences
programme.desc: Dans cette comédie romantique, Matthew Perry (Chandler de la série télé 'Friends') est Alex Whitman, un New-yorkais envoyé à Las Vegas pour superviser un projet de construction. Il y rencontre Isabel Fuentes (Salma Hayek, Desperado), et une attraction certaine les réunit le temps d'une nuit. Mais Alex ne revoit Isabel que trois mois après, quand elle lui apprend qu'elle est enceinte. Sur un coup de tête, il la demande en mariage. Mais Alex et Isabel découvrent très vite qu'un mariage ne se résume pas qu'à une chapelle à Las Vegas et un imitateur d'Elvis.

programme.title: Borat, nouvelle mission filmée
programme.desc: Dans cette suite hilarante, le quatrième meilleur journaliste du Kazakhstan, Borat Sagdiyev, doit offrir un "cadeau" au vice-président américain.

programme.title: Storm Chasers
programme.desc: Un ingénieur négligé est envoyé en Alaska pour vérifier l'affirmation d'un scientifique excentrique selon laquelle la capture de la foudre peut constituer une nouvelle source d'énergie renouvelable.

programme.title: Détestables Nous
programme.desc: Trois amis d'enfance organisent un complot afin de trouver une copine pour Barry, leur ami d'enfance insupportable, vulgaire et désagréable. Leur plan se retourne contre eux quand sa nouvelle petite amie se révèle tout aussi détestable que lui.

programme.title: Madea's Family Reunion (Affaire de femmes)
programme.desc: Une matriarche qui ne se laisse pas faire tente d'organiser une réunion de famille pour rassembler sa famille à un moment où elle ne pourrait pas être plus divisée.

programme.title: Simplement irrésistible
programme.desc: Un cadre d'un grand magasin essaye de ne pas tomber amoureux d'une jeune femme qui, selon lui, acquiert des pouvoirs magiques depuis qu'elle a hérité d'un restaurant.

programme.title: Les Vengeurs de l'Ave Maria

programme.desc: Broadcaster Carol Vorderman discusses her early life, from her family running away with the circus and living out of a car, to being one of the first girls to read engineering at Cambridge University. She reveals who wrote her first application to Countdown and explains why everything about our lives is political, from the pressure put on kids and parents by schools to women's bodily autonomy.

programme.title: Poorna Bell On How To Put Yourself First
programme.desc: Award-winning journalist and author Poorna Bell joins Fearne to talk about ageing, ambition, marriage, motherhood, grief and the quiet rage that can build when women feel invisible. From challenging the narrative that women "disappear" in midlife, to questioning the myth of "having it all", this conversation is about reclaiming agency, on your own terms.

programme.title: Liz Earle On Her Perimenopause And Midlife Reinvention
programme.desc: Broadcaster and healthy ageing expert Liz Earle discusses her transformation from overwhelmed, overweight, and exhausted during perimenopause to thriving in her 60s. She shares the lifestyle shifts that improved her health, including the importance of morning light and circadian rhythms, strength training, sleep, and consistency in wellbeing.

programme.title: Ruby Wax On Why Trump Scares Her!
programme.desc: Have you noticed that your memory and rational thinking disappear when you're anxious? Ruby Wax wants you to retrain your focus and attention in a digital world that's always trying to steal it. In this chat with Fearne – live from the Happy Place Festival – Ruby explains the difference between mental health and mental illness, and why she calls meditation 'mind gym'.

programme.title: Dr Julie on Triggers And Behaviour Patterns
programme.desc: Psychologist Dr Julie Smith discusses why criticism hurts so deeply, explaining how your brain needs evidence rather than mantras to build self-worth and change your critical inner voice. She explores why feedback from others can trigger old wounds and how patterns developed in childhood keep replaying in adulthood.

programme.title: Ruth Langsford On Coping With Grief & Loss
programme.desc: Broadcaster Ruth Langsford opens up about navigating divorce, grief, and the emotional reality of caring for parents with dementia. From therapy breakthroughs to the power of female friendships, Ruth shares the tools that have helped her find strength in life's most difficult moments. Fearne and Ruth compare their experiences of mum guilt, and why it's so important for young boys in particular to see the women in their life working. Ruth also reveals the sliding doors moment that led her to her TV presenting career. Content warning: this episode contains conversations about grief after suicide.

programme.title: Zayn Malik's Secret to Slow Living
programme.desc: Musician Zayn talks through the quiet lifestyle he loves in Pennsylvania: painting, being outdoors, spending time with his daughter, and staying off his phone. He explains how fatherhood has changed him, whether he's the parent he thought he would be, and what impact the new depths of emotion he feels has had on his music.

programme.title: Old People Try Bizarre Food
programme.desc: The Old People are back, this time taking on some of the internet's most bizarre celebrity food combinations. From viral TikTok trends to A-list guilty pleasures, they try and rate Dua Lipa's Pickle Diet Coke, Channing Tatum's Peanut Butter, Jelly & Cheetos Sandwich, and Beyoncé's Banana with Ketchup. Will these celebrity creations be surprisingly delicious or completely disgusting. Our Old People give their brutally honest verdicts.

programme.title: Keir Starmer's Weirdest Moments As Prime Minister
programme.desc: Keir Starmer's time in office has come to a close. His legacy includes some strange moments. From meeps to releasing sausages to going footy mad, relive all of the best and worst moments from the last two years. Hear clashes with Rishi Sunak and Kemi Badenoch, awkward encounters with Donald Trump, and gaffes at various major summits.

programme.title: AI CEOs Being Absolutely Insane
programme.desc: Have you ever paid attention to the voices behind the 'inevitable' AI revolution? OpenAI's Sam Altman, SpaceX's Elon Musk, and Palantir's Alex Karp are among the tech elite. They're building the models they claim will change work, politics, and life forever. But when they talk about this future, their rhetoric ranges from bizarre to sinister. From Musk's prediction that there's "a 10 to 20% chance of killer robots wiping out humanity" to Altman's sale of intelligence as utility, things look pretty bleak.

programme.title: Donald Trump's Most Embarrassing Moments
programme.desc: Donald Trump has a lot to say about the world. That doesn't mean he knows what he's talking about. From China to Venezuela and Canada to the UK, watch Trump's questionable comments about all corners of the globe.

programme.title: Gary Stevenson Interview
programme.desc: Gary Stevenson, economist and ex-Citibank trader, returns to PoliticsJOE just days after Andy Burnham became Prime Minister. Stevenson explains why he expects Labour to dodge serious taxation of the ultra-wealthy, instead quietly shifting the burden onto the upper middle class through moves like equalising capital gains and income tax. He breaks down why cutting VAT on energy bills is a quick political win rather than a real fix, and why he believes every government that fails to tax extreme wealth eventually gets forced into austerity, creating fertile ground for Reform and Farage.

programme.title: Generational
programme.desc: Episode 2 of Generational, a series bringing together football fans from every generation to debate the biggest talking points in the game. Topics include whether the Premier League has ruined football, if players from the 60s and 70s could cope in today's game, whether Jack Grealish is better than Pelé, if the FA Cup is still a major trophy, and whether Manchester City should be stripped of their trophies if found guilty. Different generations bring different perspectives, experiences and opinions, with plenty of disagreement and passionate arguments throughout.

programme.title: On The Ground at CPAC GB
programme.desc: Why are transatlantic forces of the right assembling in North Greenwich? Andy Twelves investigates CPAC GB, the new offshoot of America's longstanding Conservative Political Action Conference that hopes to unite the right in the UK. Attendees range from Tories like Liz Truss and Jacob Rees-Mogg to online voices like Young Bob and nationalist influencer Angloid to Americans who have made the trip across the pond. Nigel Farage attended the second day of the conference, and other speakers included Matt Goodwin and Matt Schlapp, CPAC's chair. Watch various factions of the right, from Conservatives to the Reform and Restore curious, fight for their ideas in speaking halls and a dimly lit expo centre.

programme.title: JOE Pub Quiz with TommyInnit and Max Fosh
programme.desc: TommyInnit and Max Fosh go head-to-head in the Joe Pub Quiz with a YouTube twist, battling it out across rounds testing their knowledge of the platform, iconic YouTube moments and some of the biggest names in internet history. From guessing who said which iconic line, to throwback YouTube apologies from Logan Paul, classic Sidemen diss tracks and a final rapid-fire round where they have to identify famous YouTubers from photos. Along the way, Tommy and Max also get into some of the biggest debates in YouTube history, including whether we need to bring proper YouTube apologies back, the golden era of diss tracks and what KSI leaving the Sidemen means for them.

programme.title: The Movie Elimination Quiz

programme.title: Ne-Yo Rates British Food, Tea, & Slang
programme.desc: Ne-Yo takes on The British Test, from making the perfect British cup of tea to trying Scampi Fries for the first time. The R&B superstar is thrown headfirst into UK culture, talks about what it means to perform in the UK, reveals why he'd love to be the 'Black Ed Sheeran', discusses what it's like to work with Pitbull, admits his crush on Leona Lewis, gives his thoughts on UK style, and hilariously trolls Jake Paul along the way.

programme.title: On The Ground At Tommy Robinson's Rally
programme.desc: Around 60,000 people gathered at Parliament Square on 16 May for Tommy Robinson's Unite The Kingdom rally, ostensibly to defend freedom, protect children, and take the country back. It was the smaller of two protests in central London, with at least a quarter of a million attending a pro-Palestine rally commemorating the 78th anniversary of the Nakba and uniting against the far-right. On the rally's main stage, a man covered in bacon played the cello.

programme.title: Hugh Jackman Takes On The Irish Test
programme.desc: Hugh Jackman steps up to the ultimate Irish test, trying his hand at making a proper Irish breakfast with mixed results, sharing thoughts on Ryan Reynolds, and tackling classic Irish challenges. Expect plenty of laughs and chaos as Hugh takes on various Irish cultural tasks.

programme.title: Kneecap Interview
programme.desc: Kneecap joined PoliticsJOE following the dismissal of their terror case against member Mo Chara in the British courts. The band discussed the legal proceedings, which centred on allegations that Chara displayed a Hezbollah flag during a London concert in November 2024. UK prosecutors had argued this could constitute an offence under the Terrorism Act, but the case was thrown out due to procedural failures.

programme.title: Glen Powell Takes The Irish Test
programme.desc: Glen Powell and Edgar Wright are put to the test to see if they can earn themselves an honourary Irish passport. To do so, they must pass a series of tests to prove their Irishness. programme.title: Hidden UK
programme.desc: For its tiny size the UK is a hugely varied landscape with a surprising collection of natural history – from the English Channel and famous white cliffs, to ancient forests and dramatic mountains. Indisputably stunning landscapes, providing homes for noble stags, soaring eagles, playful dolphins and endlessly entertaining otters. And this is just the tip of the iceberg – countless discoveries are waiting to be unearthed if you decide step off the beaten track in search of the hidden UK.

programme.title: Monkey Mayhem
programme.desc: Monkeys: loveable, aggressive, diverse and full of mischief. Our distant cousins have much in common with us. They're intelligent, cooperative and have complex relationships. They're some of the most evolutionary successful species on the planet, successful across the globe from Japanese snow monkeys to African baboons. Swinging through our family tree quickly reveals the diversity of our monkey relatives. They come in all shapes and sizes, and are certainly not as different from us as we might think.

programme.title: Seals
programme.desc: Life is rarely easy for seals, and yet all over the world they consistently rise to the challenge – and always have fun doing it.

programme.title: Last of the Right Whales
programme.desc: North Atlantic right whales are dying faster than they can reproduce. With less than 400 remaining, these great whales rarely die of natural causes. Instead they are run over by ships or suffer lethal injuries from fishing gear. If we don't stop killing them, in 20 years they could be extinct. From the only known calving grounds to the shifting feeding grounds, ‘Last of the Right Whales' follows the North Atlantic right whale migration and the people committed to saving a species still struggling to recover from centuries of hunting.

programme.title: Endangered with Michaela Strachan
programme.desc: Seeks to find the rare and endangered species of South Africa and establish what we need to do to conserve them. Documenting and recording the status of our endangered species by region.

programme.title: Wild Waters
programme.desc: From the highest mountain to the lowest valley, rivers and streams are freshwater highways, de-livering essential life blood to all kinds of wildlife. From some of the most iconic species like the otter and the trout, to the unfamiliar and elusive, like the delicate harvest mouse. Life on these freshwater freeways can be tough, and for many it's a constant battle just to stay alive. Take a break from the oceans and turn to the rivers and streams, home to the real wild waters of the nat-ural world.

programme.title: Spots and Stripes
programme.desc: Whether spots or stripes, markings can be used for anything from communication to cooling. What look like standout fashion statements to us can help animals vanish completely into a landscape. The design possibilities are endless, and vary to suit the terrain and geography. Whatever their remarkable uses, spots and stripes adorn some of the most iconic animals in the natural world. Camouflage or decoration, we can thank both spots and stripes for handing these creatures their unique and majestic beauty.

programme.title: Elephants: Back to the Wild
programme.desc: We accompany the first steps of a two-year-old elephant who is just starting his release program. We also observe the story of two young elephants in their first night in the wilderness on their own. Captivating film footage allows us to truly learn how elephants behave in the wild.

programme.title: Italy My Love
programme.desc: In ten coastal areas of Italy, we encounter people that have a very special relationship with their region. All of them love their country, their traditions and their work. We met with enthusiasts and hedonists that permitted us to take a glimpse into their everyday lives. Young Italians, who have rediscovered nature and its treasures. Others, that preserve the beauty, archaeologists that apply whole new methods, farmers that only cultivate that which the soil needs. Fishermen, who fish in the same way as it was done a century ago and tough, young men who play and dance the Tarantella. Dolphins, giant sea turtles and pink flamingos, which are researched, nursed back to health or simply observed. Cave explorers, sail makers and coffee specialists are also part of the big picture. Flying drone cameras provide birds-eye views and are an important element of the films. The results are spectacular images from completely different angles which provide us with landscape overviews and detailed insights, the likes of which have never been seen before.

programme.title: Wild Alpine Rivers
programme.desc: What would happen to the mountains without water? They would turn into deserts, devoid of life and vegetation. But there are very few mountains without water on our planet. They take care of this themselves, creating their life's element and taking water directly from the sky by entrapping the clouds around them. This water then collects on the flanks of the mountains, where it turns from rivulets into rivers, that flow out into the oceans. Mountains and water are symbiotic, a cycle that keeps life on earth going. Mountain streams slowly move along meadows before, only moments later, turning into the spray of waterfalls or small mystic lakes. What kind of life can be found in and around this mysterious cosmos? We will investigate the world of the rare Danube salmon and be there to see the Danube bleak spawn. We will follow giant wels catfish into their hideouts, see great crested grebes on their underwater hunting. We go diving under the ice of frozen mountain streams and lakes, discovering life where none was thought possible.

programme.title: Faroe Islands
programme.desc: The Faroe Islands in the North Atlantic, located in the middle of the Gulf Stream between Scotland and Iceland, are an archipelago of eighteen green volcanic islands where a unique culture has developed over the last thousand years. As direct descendants of the Vikings, the Faroese feel committed to their traditions and hold on to customs, without missing out on the advantages of the modern and globalised world - from archaic hunter and shepherd culture to contemporary art. With the highest birth rate in Europe and the lowest social inequality in the world, the just fifty thousand Faroese are a very special people living on one of the last natural paradises in Europe.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo
programme.desc: The Congo, mighty and deep like no other river - yet still a retreat and a habitat for several of our world's strangest animals. Our closest relatives live deep inside the dense jungles: three of the four giant ape species have made the Congo basin their home. Rich in extraordinary footage, the second episode of "Myths of the Congo" also presents exciting insights into one of the most mysterious and dangerous regions on earth.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo
programme.desc: The river that swallows all rivers - this is what the natives call it. In reality, the Congo, when considering its water masses, is the second largest and the deepest river in the world. At its source in the north of Zambia, it starts out as a mere trickle, but on its journey westwards it grows and grows, becoming ever mightier and with it, the animals, too: the shoebill stork hides in the dense papyrus. Metre-long pythons hunt for their prey in trees and huge hippos fight for power and respect in the water. To survive in the Congo, animals have to adapt to extreme conditions. Here, evolution has spawned unique creatures: fish with lungs, wings and those that go hunting on land. The Congo River feeds the second largest rainforest on earth. Here is the home of the forest elephant. Time and again, they are summoned to this one, magic place: the Dzanga Bay. Countless other forest dwellers join them. What makes this place so special?

programme.title: Wild Switzerland
programme.desc: Gentle, green meadows, rugged rock faces, mysterious lakes, dense forests, tall mountains, low-lying river deltas, quietly meandering mountain streams and smack dab in the middle, a unique fauna - THIS is Switzerland! We trace the elementary power of nature and present animals and plants in landscapes that have hardly ever been touched by mankind. Switzerland is an alpine country, but it is also Europe's surge tank. Rivers such as the Rhine and the Rhone have their sources here. Glaciers, crevasses, icy cold caves and the underwater dome of the Verzasca are the unusual settings we chose for this film. We meet with rare, selected animal species and present their behavioural patterns, such as the Swiss or Arven jay, the lynx and albino catfish. Cold, wind, snow and extreme locations demand adaptation that make us marvel.

programme.title: Europe's far North
programme.desc: Lofoten is the rugged archipelago in the Norwegian Arctic Ocean. Whoever arrives here is really at the end. Moskenes is the end of the line, and anyone who wants to go further needs a boat or a plane. The only way to get to the open sea is via the Maelstrom, which is quite dangerous. On the outermost headland, there are only a few ruins left. The last inhabitants are long gone, a supply was hardly possible. But fishermen are on the way, mainly to catch cod. And there is the coastal administration, which takes care of broken sea marks and lighthouses. A visit to one of the luxurious ships of the Hurtig Line is not to be missed. They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. programme.title: Between Denmark and Latvia
programme.desc: The Baltic Sea is the youngest on earth and didn't evolve until after the last Ice Age. It seems so familiar, yet offers many surprises. The shores of the Baltic Sea are still shaped by wind and waves. The first episode takes us from Denmark's northernmost corner, via the Darss Peninsula in Germany and Lithuania's Curonian Spit to the endless beaches of Latvia. The film begins at the gateway to the Baltic Sea at Denmark's northernmost point: Skagen. It is here that the North Sea and the Baltic Sea meet and form a divide made of sand between Skagerrak and Kattegat. In June, hundreds of seals gather together on the lonely island of Anholt between Denmark and Sweden. It is the largest seal colony in the Baltic Sea. No camera team has ever been able to get so close to the animals as nature filmmaker Christoph Hauschild. Using remote-control cameras, he and his team have been able to capture intimate images of the way the seals live over and beneath water. For the very first time they follow a mother with her young to swimming lessons and in doing so, capture very emotional moments of these timid creatures. Most of the freshwater from the North Sea to the Baltic Sea, flows through the Store Baelt. In this sound, the underwater world is characterised by many species of saltwater loving fish. In the waters around Sjaelland, the largest stocks of harbour porpoise in the Baltic Sea. In 2016, the labyrinth of islands, sounds and fjords attracted two dolphins. They spent several months in the fjords of Flensburg and Kiel. Astounding images: they show familiar to us from the Mediterranean, but not something we would necessarily expect from the Baltic Sea.

programme.title: To the South

They look like a mixture between hamsters and rabbits. From his hideout Benny Rebel manages to observe impressive Ibexes, a kind of wild goats with huge horns. Equipped with a special microcopter and night shot camera traps he tries to get a sneak into the life of shy inhabitants of the steppe. In his adventure he encounters lonesome dromedary herds and discovers a spooky cave of hyenas. Rebel witnesses owls, snakes and lizards living between the antique ruins of the old Persian capital Persepolis. Benny Rebel also is interested in the relationship between men and nature. He meets not only ranger in the wild, but also visitors of the magnificent Persian gardens in the middle of rough deserts. Between the fountains of freshly sputtering water pelicans take a bath. Young and old people walk in the green paradises in front of attractive mosques. Unexpected the 43 year old photographer meets animal lovers on the roof tops of urban houses. The bet on the flying skills of their specific breed of pigeons. And like a house from a fairy tale seem the historical pigeon towers with their unique architecture housing more than ten thousands of birds. Finally Benny Rebel traces an Asiatic cheetah in the semi desert. Less than a hundred of the big cats are left in the wild. The nature conservationist and photographer decides to come closer to the dangerous carnivore.

programme.title: Black Out
programme.desc: The power is out in all of Ninjag, but the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord has disappeared. Some mysterious Stranger has stolen it and is now sending alternatively powered Nindroids to attack the Ninja and capture Lloyd. After destroying the Power Station, the Ninja have dealt a massive blow to the Nindroids, but find getting back to the city troublesome without power. At the Junk Yard, Zane gives half of his heart to revive Pixal to help give guidance in their greater mission. Meanwhile, a mysterious cloaked Interloper steals the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord and creates a new foe for the Ninja to fight… Tech Wu. On the other side of Ninjago, Lloyd is trained by his father to harness his Golden Power to unlock an even greater potential – the power of the First Spinjtzu Master.

programme.title: The Curse Of The Golden Master
programme.desc: The Stranger and the hard drive with the Digital Overlord are still missing. The ninjas' search for them brings them deep underground where they are assisted by an old enemy. But the Stranger and his Nindroids are getting ever closer to capturing Lloyd. The Ninja return to a powerless New Ninjago City and visit the Serpentine Tombs in effort to solve who had taken the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord – only to discover the snakes have gone straight. They learn of Serpentine Lore that a Golden Master will conquer all of Ninjago. The Nindroids attack, but with the help from Scales and his Serpentine ilk, they fight off the enemy and discover the culprit they are after is none other than Pythor! But it's too late… the Digital Overlord and his henchman have captured Lloyd in a plot to sap his Golden Power to finally become flesh.

programme.title: Enter The Digiverse
programme.desc: Pythor the Anachondrai and his Nindroids have captured Lloyd and are draining his golden powers to bring the Overlord back into Ninjago. And the Ninja must use the Techno Blades in a daring rescue … inside the Overlord's corrupted hard drive. Unable to save Lloyd in time, the Ninja resort to drastic measures. With the help from Borg's advanced technology, the Ninja get digitized with their Techno Blades into the Digiverse in order to battle the Digital Overlord on his own turf and erase evil for good. While the Ninja learn new capabilities and explore the fantasy of a ‘digital world', their friends must protect them from Pythor and his army in the ‘real world'. In the climatic conclusion, the Ninja ‘reboot the system' and save Sensei Wu and Lloyd, but the Digital Overlord has managed to become flesh in the nick of time, only to be in a weakened state.

programme.title: The Invitation
programme.desc: When the Ninja receive an invitation to partake in the Tournament of Elements and a clue that Zane might be alive, they accept and travel to a Lost Island owned by notorious crime lord Master Chen in order to save their friend. The loss of Zane has fractured the team of Ninja, but when a mysterious invitation to Master Chen's ‘Tournament of Elements' arrives, everything is thrown into question – Is Zane alive, and are there others out there with powers like them? Sensei Garmadon warns them not to trust Master Chen, but they go in order to find Zane and make the team whole. On route to the island, the Ninja are briefly introduced to the other unique fighters with elemental powers, and the mysterious and beautiful Skylor intrigues Kai. Kai gets into a humbling scrap with Karlof, the Master of Metal, and learns some fights must be done on your own.

programme.title: The King's Tournament
programme.desc: Rival to the King, Jorah Tightwad thinks his knights – the Tighty Knighties – are easily better than the NEXO-Knights, so he challenges King Halbert to prove who's better during the King's Birthday Tournament. It's the King's birthday! To celebrate, the Queen and Macy always throw him a great, big birthday party consisting of a feast on birthday eve and a tournament the next day. At the birthday banquet is JORAH TIGHTWAD (last seen in episode 104.) He's goading the King (and on his birthday, even) and going on and on about how his knights are better than the NEXO-Knights. The King protests, but Jorah asks “How many magical books have your knights recovered? None, zilch, zero.” But he produces the BOOK OF ENVY, which his superior knights captured from Jestro. The next day, the NEXO-Knights square off against Tightwad's four knights: JOUSTING BEEBER, BRICKNEY SPEARS, SHIA LABLADE and THE BLOK. We see that all these knights are envious of the NEXO-Knights: their weapons, their fame, their hair, etc. Macy is also disappointed to find out she CAN'T fight in the tournament – she's agreed to be in “princess mode” for her father's birthday. During the tournament, we see that Tightwad's knights are amazing in fighting contests. They all pair-off with knights who have their same weapons skills. Tightwad makes fun of the NEXO-Knights as his knights do well. Jestro and the Book of Monsters discover that Tightwad has the Book of Envy and he and his monsters attack the tournament. Then we learn that Tightwad's knights might be good tournament fighters, but they can't handle real fights and the NEXO-Knights must save them! Macy is finally able to join in the fight when she sees Magmar show up on the flank. The NEXO-Knights successfully defend the king, but Jestro gets away with the Book of Envy. Tightwad must admit his knights never won the book from Jestro he got the book when Merlok blasted books of magic across the realm. Tightwad's knights all admit that they really admire the NEXO-Knights.

programme.title: Monster Chef
programme.desc: Axl and Chef Éclair must enter a cooking contest to try to keep Jestro from getting the hottest chili recipe in the realm. Knighton celebrity chef GOBBLETON RAMBLEY announces that he's developed the hottest chili recipe ever created. Now, he intends to give the recipe to the winner of his “Hottest Chili Cook-Off Competition” cooking show on Knighton TV. He'll turn over his famous Chili Cookbook with the hottest chili recipe on the last page. It's so unique it can't be recreated without it. Jestro and the Book of Monsters think they MUST have that recipe. “Hot chili makes hot monsters!” Merlok knows that this recipe, in the wrong hands – meaning Jestro's – could be dangerous. But when the Knights appeal to the egomaniacal chef, he says the only way to get the recipe is to win it from him. So Axl and Chef Éclair decide to enter. The team that creates the hottest chili will win Rambley's cookbook. Chef Éclair is unsure that Axl has the skills to help them win the competition, but, as we see through funny cooking show bits, Axl is quite good and they become a pretty good team. (We will also learn that years ago, Rambley stole one of Éclair's best recipes and they don't like each other.) While watching the multi-part competition, Aaron and Lance have a contest of their own: who can eat the hottest chili. Axl and Éclair actually win the competition, coming up with a raging hot chili recipe. Before they can claim their prize, Jestro and his monsters attack with Magmar leading the way on his siege tower. They must get that cookbook! During the battle, Rambley's cookbook is accidentally melted. After the battle, Rambley announces his new quest: to make the sweetest ice cream ever! While Axl and Éclair cook happily in the kitchen of the Fortrex, back in the Redoubt of Ruination, Jestro and Lavaria are attempting to recreate Rambley's chili recipe. They keep spooning various recipes of chili into the Book of Monsters. “Nope, not hot enough…waaaay too much garlic….you call that hot?!” (BELCH!)

programme.title: Knight Out
programme.desc: When the other NEXO-Knights decide they need a vacation from Clay, they send him on a holiday not knowing that he's going to a resort that houses an evil book or that Jestro will be heading there, too. Clay needs a vacation. Or, actually, the knights need a vacation from Clay! Clay is so super-focused that sometimes they just can't take it: training, training, maintenance, the Knights' Code tests then…more training. Even Merlok 2.0 is exhausted and he has no physical form! So, the Knights send Clay off on a holiday against his will (arranged by Lance because if there's one thing he can do it's plan a vacation.) But unbeknownst to the other Knights, Jestro and the Book of Monsters are tracking an evil book. A book that they suspect is located near the resort “Exalted Towers” renowned for its exquisite service, where Clay is staying. It's the BOOK OF CRUELTY and Clay notices that it's affecting the “high class” resort where Lance has booked him: the service is terrible, the staff is nasty, and everyone seems to take joy in being cruel to him (and to each other.) Meanwhile, the other Knights are having a terrible time because they realize that Clay takes charge of the basic maintenance of almost everything in the Fortrex. Stuff starts breaking down, chores are not getting done and everyone is getting on each other's nerves. Clay senses things are “off” at the resort, and discovers the book they've been using as the guest register is really the Book of Cruelty. As Clay scoops it up, he looks outside to see…Jestro and his monsters arrive on the Evilmobile. Clay battles as best he can on his own by setting traps and being cunning but he's finally caught. Just when it looks like this will be the cruelest vacation ever the other Knights arrive on their vehicles! They spring into action, free Clay, and battle and defeat Jestro and the monsters – though Jestro escapes. The Knights make Clay promise to never go on vacation again.

The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There was a village and a man, living in this village. In a deep forest near that village, the Bear settled in. The Bear asked the man for some tasty treats. The Bear asked the man to try the turnip. The man agreed on the condition that the Bear will help him with the housework and keep off the flies. While chasing away the flies, the Bear accidentally hit the man on the nose. The Bear was scared and ran away into the forest, grabbing the turnip with him. Since then, people use to say “to be a fool for one's pains”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This story is about one very kind, but very poor Ali-Baba and his rich but greedy brother Kasym. Once upon a time Ali-Baba overheard the magic spell, which opens up the magic cape with numerous treasures. These treasures were stolen by the thieves and kept in this cave. One day Ali-Baba met Kasym and told him the secret spell. Kasym got inside the cape, but accidentally forgot the spell and the thieves caught him. They forced Kasym to learn the whole book of fairy tales by heart and spend one thousand days and a thousand and one nights telling these stories to them. This story teaches us to study well and avoid cheating.

programme.title: Masha's Tales

programme.desc: This is a story about the small but brave boy. The moral of the story is that no matter how big and tall you are, you should not offend the little ones. It may happen so that you will meet some tom thumb boy, who will beat any “giant”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a woman who had three daughters - two of her own and the stepdaughter called Wee Little Havroshechka. Once upon a time the stepmother kicked her out of the house, but every medal has its flipside – Wee Little Havroshechka met her Prince and they lived happily ever after, and it's all because she was hard-working and clean.

programme.sub-title: Sinister Saga Of A Sick Tummy And A Girl Who Was Afraid Of Doctors
programme.desc: Masha narrates a terrific story about one little girl who was afraid of doctors. And once upon a time she experienced one fantastic story…she decided to cook dinner for her dolls. Nobody knows how long she would need to suffer, but when she woke up…she realized herself in hospital…near the real snow queen… who explained that medical treatment is not scary at all…though some other things are very fearsome! Oh yeah!

programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Everyone think that it's so scary to be little as there are so many things are not accessible for you! But in reality there is no difference how little you are if there is someone who cares for you and someone you care about…

programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Some people happen to believe in all sorts of omens like black cats, wearing clothes inside out, prophetic dreams… Poor girl Lucy believed in that kind of stuff so much that was even afraid to go outside to play with her friends. programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories
programme.sub-title: Terrifying True Story About Monsters And Those Who Fear Them
programme.desc: Are you afraid of monsters? Sure you are! Let me tell you a scary story about a boy who experienced a real fear…This story happened on an abandoned tractor factory. The boy lost a scoop from his toy-tractor and decided to look for it at the factory. So he goes up the stairs and sees a large female monster, who was about to paint her lips with a roller! As he kept walking he noticed more monsters playing domino! The boy was very terrified and about to cry, when he learnt that it was just a movie set and all the monsters were not real! They were just actors…Finally the boy realized that all the monsters from the books and movies are not real at all! But if want to see a real monster- watch a fly under a microscope!

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. In the forest, Yegor met a starling, which turned into a beautiful girl. The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a Tsar with his three sons. The oldest son married on nobleman's daughter, the second one married the merchant's daughter, while the youngest son - on the Frog. This is the only way they could appeal to your concerns and become your faithful friends.

Finding himself the lone survivor of a failed emigration attempt, his escape pod floats mindlessly in space and his oxygen is running low. His only chance of survival is to hook up to a rogue Rhean supply ship called The Nysa running on auxiliary power. But after finding the crew on board The Nysa dead, it seems Bran may have more than just a hostile planet to worry about. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: I'm LIVE Ep.307
programme.desc: FRankly is made up of vocalist and guitarist Jung Seung-Hwan, guitarist Na Hyung-chul, drummer Ato, and bassist Koo Dong-uk. Deeply inspired by the 2000s Brit pop and American alternative rock, their music encapsulates authentic retro sentiments. However, they also display their trademark, youthful energy in many other elements of their musical work, such as album covers and song descriptions, making everyone fall for their kaleidoscopic qualities.In this episode, FRankly performs “TR,” “Grow Up!,” “DD (Drunk Dreaming,” “Help me,” and their latest single “Novel.”

programme.title: I'm LIVE Ep.308
programme.desc: BAND NAH is comprised of guitarist and vocalist Nah Sang-hyun, drummer Kang Hyun-woong, and bassist PAIIEK. This 88io debuted in 2015 with the EP, “Tingling,” and has released about 90 songs since then. Impressively enough, their music is as diverse as it is prolific. They have been evolving in unpredictable ways every time while maintaining their delightful spirit - no wonder why they are highly sought after for concerts and festivals.In this episode, BAND NAH performs “Shine,” which they released early this year, “Love Love Love,” Spotlight“ featured on the sound88ack of ”Yumi's Cells,“ ”88,“ and ”1+1“ to showcase the essence of their musicality.

programme.title: I'm LIVE Ep.310
programme.desc: In this episode, Isaac Hong X Sooyoung Chin performs their songs “(n)everland,” “a bird,” “pages,” and also Hong's own pieces “Rain” and “Stay.”Tune in to I'm LIVE and join their beautiful jazzy conversation!Joining us on this week's episode of I'm LIVE is Isaac Hong X Sooyoung Chin!Isaac Hong made himself known to the public with his Yoo Jae-ha Music Contest-winning self-written song “Spring” in 2013. Since then, he has steadily built up his own musical world, marked by his trademark, mellow vocals and delicate sentiments. This time, he collaborated with renowned jazz pianist Sooyoung Chin to drop their project album, “Everland.” It is a mostly English-language album made through months of full collaboration, and the two describe it as “a record of their conversations over piano.” Using the common language of music, the two expanded their reach into each other's respective universes.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

programme.title: time2Rlx Nature Walks
programme.desc: Explore the lush jungle paths of Hawaii's Tropical Botanical Garden, surrounded by vibrant tropical plants, birdsong, and the soothing sound of forest streams. A perfect retreat for nature lovers.

programme.title: time2Rlx Landscape
programme.desc: Immerse yourself in stunning nature scenes, accompanied by piano music and calming sounds. Let the beauty of mountains, forests, lakes, and seas relax your mind and promote tranquility.

programme.title: Brivido di sangue
programme.desc: Con Jude Law, un thriller-horror sensuale e avvolgente. Steven è affascinante e irresistibile, ma le sue relazioni finiscono sempre in tragedia, attirando l'attenzione della polizia. Quando incontra Anna, nasce una passione travolgente… ma il loro amore nasconde un prezzo altissimo, in un gioco pericoloso tra attrazione e fatalità.

programme.title: Pain Threshold
programme.desc: Quattro amici viaggiano verso il monte Altaj per un'escursione in rafting. Lontani dalla civiltà e immersi nella natura più spietata e selvaggia, potranno contare unicamente sul loro istinto. Nella lotta per la sopravvivenza, capire di chi fidarsi non sarà facile.

programme.title: Walled in – Murata viva
programme.desc: Un agghiacciante horror tratto dal romanzo Les Emmurés del francese Serge Brussolo. Appena laureatasi, Sam (Mischa Barton) viaggia fino ad una remota località di campagna per supervisionare la demolizione di un palazzo, sede di macabri delitti. Alcune persone, sono state sepolte vive e Sam, dopo accurate ricerche sulla storia del palazzo, crede di essere la prossima.

programme.title: The Harbinger – Presagio di morte
programme.desc: Quando una famiglia si trasferisce con la figlia in difficoltà in una piccola città e i vicini iniziano a morire misteriosamente, temono che qualcosa di malvagio li abbia seguiti.

programme.title: SON
programme.desc: Dopo che un misterioso gruppo di individui irrompe nella casa di Laura e tenta di rapire suo figlio David di otto anni, i due fuggono dalla città in cerca di un posto sicuro. Dopo il rapimento fallito, David si ammala gravemente, soffrendo di psicosi e convulsioni sempre più frequenti. Seguendo il suo istinto materno per salvarlo, Laura dovrà compiere atti indicibili per mantenerlo in vita.

programme.title: GRETEL E HANSEL
programme.desc: In una terra lontana, due fratelli, Hansel e Gretel, vagano per i boschi in cerca di cibo e lavoro. Quando una misteriosa signora offre loro una via d'uscita, accettano senza pensare alle conseguenze.

programme.title: SPRING
programme.desc: Quando sua madre muore, Evan decide di fare un viaggio in Europa e arriva in Italia, dove partecipa a feste con altri turisti. Ma tutto cambia per Evan quando, giunto in un'idilliaca città del Sud, incontra l'incantevole Louise. Tra i due comincia a nascere una storia d'amore, ma Louise nasconde un oscuro segreto primordiale che potrebbe distruggere la loro felicità.

programme.title: UNA VICINA QUASI PERFETTA
programme.desc: Grace, rimasta vedova per un "incidente", decide di trasferirsi in un nuovo quartirere. Qui conoscerà Robert e per catturare la sua attenzione sarà capace di ogni cosa…

programme.title: Space Kids
programme.desc: In un futuro lontano, un pianeta un tempo rigoglioso è diventato un deserto dopo la distruzione della pianta che ne garantiva la sopravvivenza. Tre giovani eroi decidono di sfidare robot, vulcani e pericoli estremi per trovare l'ultima pianta rimasta e salvare il loro mondo.

programme.title: Big Baby
programme.desc: Uno scienziato progetta una macchina per la trasformazione genetica e il suo nipotino di soli 4 anni si trasforma accidentalmente in un uomo di 30. Il "Bambino" sfugge e corre intorno alla città rincorso dai fratelli che fanno di tutto per recuperarlo prima dell'arrivo dei propri genitori.

programme.title: Nut Job – Operazione Noccioline
programme.desc: Cosa c'è di più terribile per un roditore di perdere tutte le scorte di cibo per l'inverno? Ma lo scoiattolo Surly ed i suoi amici non si perdono d'animo ed escogitano un piano per svaligiare Noceland, un fornitissimo negozio di noci, nocciole e croccanti di noccioline!

programme.title: Papaya dei Caraibi
programme.desc: A Santo Domingo, la sensuale Papaya elimina i tecnici venuti a costruire una centrale nucleare, seducendoli e consegnandoli ai ribelli che difendono la loro terra. La giornalista Sara, arrivata per caso in quel mondo di inganni e rituali voodoo, prima ne è terrorizzata, poi ne resta affascinata: tra passioni proibite, lotta politica e mistero, finirà per scegliere da che parte stare.

programme.title: In nome del padre, del figlio e della Colt
programme.desc: Billy Nolan è lo sceriffo di una cittadina del west che durante la festa di Halloween mentre si consumano i festeggiamenti sta indagando su una serie di misteriosi omicidi realizzati da un altrettanto misterioso killer che indossa un mantello con cappuccio ed un vestito neri, una sinistra maschera di cuoio ed adopera un lungo coltello per uccidere. Bill però verrà arrestato perché, accusato da due sue presunte vittime, un padre e una figlia, che lo avrebbero riconosciuto, è ritenuto responsabile di una serie di delitti e anche capo di una sanguinaria banda. In realtà però l'autore dei delitti è il suo fratello gemello malvagio Wess, e quando riuscirà a dimostrare la sua innocenza se la dovrà vedere sia col fratello che con il misterioso killer

programme.title: Peccato di castità
programme.desc: Valentina ha appena sposato Michele. Dovrebbe essere più che felice, visto che sta partendo per il viaggio di nozze e che è riuscita a superare le difficoltà che si frapponevano tra lei e il matrimonio. In realtà non è così: ha fatto voto di mantenersi vergine la prima notte di nozze ed ora non sa come spiegarlo all'ignaro marito.

programme.title: Sentivano uno strano, eccitante, pericoloso puzzo di dollari
programme.desc: Charity (Malcolm) è incaricata di consegnare le paghe della ferrovia, ma alcuni abitanti del luogo e una banda messicana hanno i loro piani per il denaro.

programme.title: Club vacanze
programme.desc: Due giovani vengono scambiati dal proprietario di un albergo per due pericolosi malviventi e la loro valigia per il bottino di una rapina. L'albergatore, per impossessarsi della valigia, li assume: uno come cameriere, l'altro come barman, provocando una serie di rocamboleschi equivoci.

programme.title: La notte
programme.desc: Nel corso di una sola giornata a Milano, uno scrittore e sua moglie attraversano ospedali, feste e incontri che mettono a nudo la crisi del loro matrimonio, la solitudine e l'incapacità di comunicare.

programme.title: Parigi è sempre Parigi
programme.desc: Un gruppo di tifosi italiani arriva a Parigi per una partita di calcio e si disperde per la città. Tra incontri romantici, piccoli guai e avventure notturne, ognuno vivrà una personale scoperta della capitale francese.

programme.title: Il mio amico Jekyll
programme.desc: Grande commedia con Ugo Tognazzi e Raimondo Vianello. Il professor Giacinto, mite direttore di un istituto per ragazze malviventi, viene ogni notte rapito da un folle soprannominato "Dottor Jekyll," che gli inietta strani sieri. Giacinto si trasforma così nel sadico Professor Fabius, compiendo atti licenziosi e violenti sulle ragazze. Il suo segreto viene infine scoperto da un poliziotto.

programme.title: La mandragola
programme.desc: Nella Firenze del Cinquecento, Callimaco escogita una beffa elaborata per conquistare la bella Lucrezia, moglie del credulone Nicia. Con l'aiuto di Ligurio e di un frate compiacente, si finge medico e mette in moto un inganno sempre più audace.

programme.title: Noi Duri
programme.desc: A Parigi un improbabile agente di polizia si trova sulle tracce di una banda di trafficanti di droga. Tra locali notturni, scambi di persona e gag, l'indagine diventa una parodia movimentata del poliziesco.

programme.title: Splendor
programme.desc: Il proprietario, il proiezionista e la maschera di una sala di provincia che sta per chiudere i battenti si abbandonano ai ricordi: ma quando gli operai stanno già schiodando le poltrone...

programme.title: L'orchestra rossa
programme.desc: L`orchestra rossa è la più importante rete di spie della seconda guerra mondiale. Si tratta di una storia incredibile ma assolutamente vera, che ricostruisce come un manipolo di audaci non professionisti di diverse nazionalità, senza alcuna esperienza sul campo, sia riuscito a tenere in scacco i nazisti sottraendo informazioni segretissime persino durante le riunioni di Hitler con i suoi generali

programme.title: La decima vittima
programme.desc: In un futuro dove le guerre sono state abolite, per dare sfogo all`aggressività dell`individuo viene legalizzata la caccia all`uomo. Una volta entrati a far parte di un club internazionale e accettate le regole, ogni membro può essere sia cacciatore che preda. Dopo dieci battute di caccia portate a termine vengono concessi onori trionfali: Caroline, alla sua nona esperienza, parte per Roma, dove vive Marcello, la sua ultima preda...

programme.title: I fuorilegge del matrimonio
programme.desc: Sei storie di matrimoni impossibili: tra leggi, ricatti e assurdità burocratiche, uomini e donne si ritrovano intrappolati in legami che non possono sciogliere. Tra manicomio, carcere, divorzio estero e conventi, l'amore si scontra con l'inflessibilità delle istituzioni, generando drammi, equivoci e amara ironia.

programme.title: Angiò
programme.desc: Il film sperimentale è basato sul romanzo “Angiò uomo d'acqua” di Lorenzo Viani. Utilizza riprese dal vivo processate per avvicinarsi graficamente all'opera di Viani, pittore, incisore e autore di xilografie di rara forza espressiva, e racconta la storia di Angelo Bertuccelli, nato in via Pinciana a Viareggio, nel 1850. Piccolo di statura, con un carattere forte e orgoglioso in un fisico deforme, marinaio, come la maggior parte degli abitanti della Viareggio di allora, che scampato alla furia dei venti a bordo del “Dedalo”, fece voto di non affrontare più il mare. Così il “navigante dell'Oceano” consuma la sua vita sempre più isolato lontano dalla cattiveria della gente che irride il suo aspetto grottesco, in un turbinio di disperazione e ribellione. Il nano dal cuore di gigante, finirà la vita travolto dalle onde della follia, annegato in un mare profondo “un uomo d'acqua”, così come previsto da un destino ostile.

programme.title: The Girl in the Book
programme.desc: Alice è un'aspirante scrittrice che non ha la vita che sognava anche a causa di un trauma personale. Sarà forzata a confrontarsi con il celebre scrittore Milan che, 15 anni prima, la sfruttò per il suo libro e abusò di lei. Dopo una serie di azioni autodistruttive, Alice dovrà andare oltre e riallacciare i rapporti con il ragazzo che ama.

programme.title: Un'altra giovinezza
programme.desc: Dominic, anziano linguista ossessionato dallo studio del linguaggio, viene colpito da un fulmine e inizia a ringiovanire, acquisendo poteri paranormali. Tra fughe dai nazisti e scoperte straordinarie, il suo percorso lo porta a riscrivere il destino della sua vita e dei suoi studi.

programme.title: Le Creature di Prometeo / Le Creaturei di Capucci
programme.desc: Un viaggio nell'arte di Roberto Capucci, icona della moda, dove 15 suoi bozzetti diventano straordinarie creazioni. Sulle note di Beethoven, la sua visione prende vita, celebrando la bellezza, il design e l'eleganza senza tempo.

programme.title: La Regina degli scacchi
programme.desc: Maria Adele, 17 anni, vive per gli scacchi, ma scopre di essere stata adottata e, con l'aiuto di un giornalista, rintraccia la madre biologica. Mentre riaffiora un ricordo d'infanzia che la libera dai tormenti, emerge un'indagine che svela crimini del suo maestro di scacchi, culminati in un tragico epilogo.

programme.title: Plus One
programme.desc: Tre amici vanno alla più grande festa dell'anno. Mentre la festa precipita nel caos i tre vedranno la loro amicizia messa in discussione e le loro stesse vite in pericolo.

programme.title: Kiss Daddy Goodnight IT
programme.desc: Laura è la classica brava ragazza dalla faccia angelica. Di notte però la sua personalità cambia aspetto e diventa una cacciatrice senza scrupoli di uomini di mezza età, vittime predestinate del suo malvagio gioco.

programme.title: Anno 2000
programme.desc: Nell'avveniristica e distopica America del duemila, si organizza una corsa da costa a costa in cui vince chi ha investito il maggior numero di passanti.

programme.title: LErba Di Grace
programme.desc: Nel disperato tentativo di salvare la sua proprietà, Grace, una vedova inglese, decide di collaborare con un giardiniere e trasformare la serra di orchidee in una coltivazione di marijuana.

programme.title: Amore Mio Aiutami
programme.desc: Tra i film più ispirati del Sordi regista. Giovanni e Raffaella sono una coppia affiatata da anni. Quando Raffaella si innamora di Valerio, chiederà aiuto proprio a suo marito per cercare di far passare l'infatuazione. Con Monica Vitti e Alberto Sordi.

programme.title: Il lato positivo
programme.desc: Adattamento cinematografico del best seller di Matthew Quick "L'orlo argenteo delle nuvole", toccante commedia sull'amore e sulle seconde occasioni della vita. Pat Peoples, ex insegnante di storia delle superiori, è stato appena dimesso da un istituto per malattie mentali.

programme.title: La Forza del Singolo
programme.desc: P.K. Newborn era l'unico bambino inglese in una scuola afrikaans. P.K. incontra il detenuto Geel Piet che gli insegna a tirare di boxe. Geel Piet diffonde il mito del Rainmaker, colui che porta la pace tra tutte le tribù, e dice a tutti che è P.K. l'eroe che stanno aspettando.

programme.title: La programmazione riprenderà a breve
programme.desc: Ci stiamo concedendo un sonno riparatore per tornare più belli di prima! Resta sintonizzato e presto arriveranno altre proposte straordinarie di intrattenimento a cura di Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Traffic
programme.desc: Javier e Manolo sono due poliziotti dell'antidroga. Il loro capo è il generale Salazar, principale nemico dei cartelli della droga. Ogni giorno i due sono tentati di appropriarsi di parte dei carichi sequestrati e di arricchirsi...

programme.title: La città verrà distrutta all'alba
programme.desc: Immaginate di vivere in una piccola città dove tutto è sicuro e felice... finché improvvisamente non lo è più. In un terrificante racconto del "Sogno Americano" andato terribilmente storto, quattro abitanti di Ogden Marsh, IA, si ritrovano intrappolati nella loro città natale.

programme.title: Awake Anestesia cosciente
programme.desc: Sebbene il suo corpo sia completamente paralizzato dall'anestesia, Clay rimane consapevole per tutta la durata dell'intervento, sperimentando così la 'consapevolezza intraoperatoria'. Questa esperienza, tra il delirio e la realtà, avrà ripercussioni nella sua vita perché emergeranno segreti nascosti.

programme.title: Blood Money
programme.desc: Tre amici trovano milioni di dollari nascosti nel bosco, ma presto scoprono che appartengono a un criminale pericoloso. L'avidità e la paura trasformano il loro legame in un conflitto mortale, mentre cercano di sopravvivere alla furia del legittimo proprietario.

programme.title: Hard night falling
programme.desc: Durante una cena nella lussuosa villa della famiglia Rossini, il criminale Goro e la sua banda prendono in ostaggio gli invitati per rubare un'ingente quantità d'oro. Ignorano però che tra gli ospiti c'è Michael Anderson (Dolph Lundgren), un agente dell'Interpol altamente addestrato, determinato a salvare la sua famiglia e sventare il colpo.

programme.title: Beastly
programme.desc: Bello e arrogante, Kyle viene trasformato in un “mostro”. Solo l'amore vero potrà salvarlo. Una favola dark dove l'apparenza non conta più.

programme.title: Fragranza d'amore
programme.desc: Dopo la morte prematura del padre, Violet deve consegnare in tempo per San Valentino la terza fragranza di una trilogia di profumi a cui ha lavorato il genitore. Per risalire alla composizione del profumo di cui non conosce la formula, decide di assumere Dec, un esperto botanico. Ben presto, la loro relazione professionale si trasformerà in qualcosa di molto più.

programme.title: Un fidanzato in regalo
programme.desc: Una donna stanca dei suoi genitori che la assillano per trovare un fidanzato fa un patto con un ragazzo che non vuole nemmeno che una relazione si atteggi a suo fidanzato per tenere lontana la sua famiglia fino a dopo la sua festa di compleanno.

programme.title: Due cuori e una baita
programme.desc: La maniaca del lavoro Jillian eredita una bellissima baita di montagna dopo la morte del suo ricco zio. Ha intenzione di venderlo, ma il bel custode Liam le fa un'offerta che non può rifiutare e le scintille volano mentre lavorano per trasformare la capanna in un resort. Ma quando gli affari non vanno secondo i piani, Jillian rinuncerà a tutto per l'amore che non ha mai visto arrivare?

programme.title: Questione Di Chimica
programme.desc: Una professoressa universitaria si prepara a presentare il suo studio che accende l'amore tra sconosciuti, ma il lancio è messo a rischio quando viene criticata per non aver mai affrontato lei stessa "Il Test degli Appuntamenti". A quel punto, non potrà più nascondersi dall'amore.

programme.title: Il mio San Valentino
programme.desc: Dopo che il suo fidanzato l'ha lasciata il giorno di San Valentino, Piper, organizzatrice di proposte di matrimonio, ha perso la fiducia nelle relazioni amorose. Lavorando ad un nuovo ingaggio, la donna conosce Adam, il fratello del promesso sposo.

programme.title: Daredevil
programme.desc: Un uomo che ha perso la vista in un incidente sviluppa superpoteri e diventa un esperto di arti marziali.

programme.title: Ricetta mortale
programme.desc: Ivy e Skyler hanno aperto un popolare sito web. La salute di Ivy risente dello stress. Il suo medico la fa scansionare. Le resta solo poco tempo da vivere. Comincia con farmaci costosi, illegali e sperimentali. Il dottore sta mentendo?

programme.title: Un amore di pasticceria
programme.desc: Jessie Dale è una pasticcera di terza generazione che ama la sua pasticceria più di ogni altra cosa al mondo. Quando i costruttori minacciano di acquistare il suo edificio per costringerla ad andarsene, Jessie Dale deve fare tutto il possibile per salvare il suo business. Tutto questo nel mezzo di una fiorente storia d'amore con il fratello di una sua cliente.

programme.title: Indiavolato

programme.desc: Quando un accordo va a monte, il proprietario di un'impresa funebre Jeremiah O'Keefe (il premio Oscar Tommy Lee Jones) si rivolge all'avvocato Willie E. Gary (il premio Oscar Jamie Foxx) per salvare la sua azienda.

programme.desc: Courtney è una chef che gestisce il ristorante di famiglia, armata di un cimelio di famiglia lasciato da suo padre chiamato "Libro delle regole dell'amore" per mostrarle la strada. Alla fine trova l'amore nel posto che meno si aspettava.

programme.title: Love on Harbor Island
programme.desc: Lily è una giovane interior designer che abita a Seattle, ma è nata e cresciuta in un piccolo paese, dove sua zia Maggie gestisce un b&b. Avendo bisogno d'aiuto, Maggie chiama la nipote per aiutarla a gestire l'azienda. Lì incontra l'affascinante Marcus.

programme.title: Once Upon a Wedding
programme.desc: Una settimana prima del suo matrimonio, una donna ferisce un uomo in un incidente stradale. Mentre si prende cura di lui, inizia a dubitare di aver fatto le scelte giuste nella vita.

programme.title: La lingua dellamore
programme.desc: Dottorato in Linguistica Julie può parlare quasi tutte le lingue. Le cose si capovolgono per Julie quando il bel Dan la contatta per prendere lezioni di francese. Volano presto scintille: potrebbe essere questo il loro abbinamento perfetto?

programme.title: Melancholia
programme.desc: Justine arriva con il neomarito alla festa delle nozze che il cognato e la sorella Claire le hanno organizzato con un ritmato protocollo. Justine sorride molto ma dentro di sé prova un disagio profondo che la spingerà ad allontanarsi in più occasioni dai festeggiamenti provocando lo sconcerto di molti, marito compreso. Non si tratta però solo di un malessere esistenziale privato. Una grave minaccia incombe sulla Terra: il pianeta Melancholia si sta avvicinando e, benché il mondo scientifico inviti all'ottimismo, il rischio di collisione e di distruzione totale del globo terrestre è più che mai realistico.

programme.title: La Finestra di Alice
programme.desc: Gabriele, aspirante scrittore pieno di debiti, passa le giornate a spiare dalla finestra la bella dirimpettaia Alice. Non riuscendo a sostenere le spese per il lussuoso appartamento avuto in eredità, il giovane decide di affittare una stanza allo spagnolo Fabio. La convivenza fra i due si rivela piuttosto complicata perché i ragazzi si scontrano spesso per via di grosse diversità caratteriali, ma poco dopo nel palazzo di Alice avviene un omicidio e Fabio diviene il principale indiziato.

programme.title: A Proposito di Noi

programme.title: Juliet, Naked
programme.desc: Annie vive una relazione abitudinaria con Duncan, fan ossessivo dell'ormai sconosciuto musicista rock Tucker Crowe. Un incontro con l'elusivo rocker che cambierà la vita di tutti i protagonisti.

programme.title: Motel Woodstock
programme.desc: Il film racconta la storia di Tiber, un uomo comune che gestiva assieme ai genitori un motel, tenendo nascosta la propria omosessualità. Tiber fu l'uomo che riuscì a trovare il luogo adatto e le licenze necessarie per dar vita ad uno degli eventi che hanno segnato la storia della musica, del costume e non solo, il Festival di Woodstock.

programme.title: The greatest movie ever sold
programme.desc: Morgan Spurlock rivela il lato nascosto del mondo del marketing attaccando con grande umorismo la pubblicità illegittima nel cinema e in televisione attraverso il cosiddetto product placement.

programme.title: Un neomelodico presidente

programme.title: Zombieland
programme.desc: Dieci anni dopo che Zombieland è diventato un film di successo e un classico cult, il cast principale (Woody Harrelson, Jesse Eisenberg, Abigail Breslin ed Emma Stone) si sono riuniti per Zombieland: Doppio Colpo. Nel sequel in cui il caos comico si estende dalla Casa Bianca attraverso il centro, questi quattro assassini devono affrontare I numerosi nuovi tipi di zombie che si sono evoluti dal primo film, così come alcuni nuovi umani sopravvissuti. Ma molti di loro devono affrontare i crescenti dolori della propria irriverente, improvvisata famiglia.

programme.title: Mr. Deeds
